definitions.short: Noach , the patriarch of the flood
definitions.full: H5146. Noach נֹחַ 46 proper name, masculine Noah (Nabataean proper name נוח Lzb 322 , Syriac proper name Meissn VOJ viii, (1894), 303 near the end (No. 116)); — Gen 5:29 (where traditional etymology), + 40 t. Genesis 5-10 (not in E D); 1Chr 1:4 ; וְאִיּוֺב דָּנִאֵל נֹחַ Ezek 14:14 , 20 ; נֹחַ מֵי = flood Isa 54:9 (twice in verse); ᵐ5 Νωε . — On history of interpretion of name see Goldziher ZMG xxiv. (1870), 207 ff .
